settings.title: Zero risk. All grip.
settings.lede: Try them on at home. If the fit isn't right, you have 30 days to send them back — and every pair is covered against defects for 90.
settings.start_body: Open the returns portal within 30 days of delivery. Choose Refund or Exchange, follow the prompts, and ship with the prepaid label.
settings.returns_body:
Initiate within 30 days of delivery for a refund when items are in new, sellable condition — clean, unused outdoors, no sole damage or scuffs.

Like buying any footwear: try them on for fit. This is not a studio trial and not “try them in class for 30 days.”

  • Performance Skins: tried on indoors only; return in the original mesh bag with tag (if supplied) and packing slip. Poly mailer OK — no shoe box required.
  • Apparel & accessories: unused, unwashed, tags attached, original packaging, packing slip.
  • US return shipping: $7.95 flat rate, deducted from refund. Prepaid label after approval.
  • Refunds: within 72 hours of inspection (bank processing may take longer).
settings.warranty_body: Every purchase is covered against manufacturing defects for 90 days from delivery. Return of the defective item is usually not required.
settings.warranty_covered:
• Manufacturing defects
  • Structural failure from defect
  • Item arrives defective (contact within 24 hours)
settings.warranty_not_covered:
• Normal wear and tear
  • Grip-surface wear from use
  • Damage from misuse or outdoor abuse
settings.shipping_body:
• Free shipping Continental US on orders over $150
  • $9.95 flat under $150 (Continental US)
  • Process 24–48 hrs; typically ship next business day
  • Expedited / overnight at checkout
  • We ship worldwide — customer pays duties/taxes/customs
settings.exchanges_body:
Wrong size? A size exchange is often faster than a refund. Start through the same returns portal within 30 days — select Exchange.

We ship your exchange at no cost to you once we receive and inspect the return.
settings.intl_body:
Duties and taxes are charged at checkout — nothing extra to pay when your order arrives.

If you need to send something back from outside the US, return shipping is the customer's. Warranty replacements are the same — the customer covers shipping and any duties on the replacement. Size carefully before ordering.
settings.process_lede: Three steps. Keep packaging if you can — condition still has to be sellable.
settings.cta_body: Sizing, claims, or a stuck return — Contact us with your order number.

settings.title: Open the returns portal
settings.description: Go to Start a return and enter your order email and order number.

settings.title: Choose Refund or Exchange
settings.description: Follow the prompts. You’ll get a prepaid label after approval for US returns.

settings.title: Ship & we’re on it
settings.description: Pack the item, drop it off, and we’ll inspect on arrival. Refunds typically process within 72 hours of inspection.
